en: A black‑and‑white aerial view of a mid‑20th‑century suburban residential district. The foreground shows tree‑lined streets with detached houses and gardens. Farther back are several blocks of 3–5‑story apartment buildings arranged in rows with open courtyards, and beyond them more single‑family homes in a grid pattern. There are open fields at the edge of the settlement, indicating ongoing development. No text or decorative postcard framing is visible on the image side.
